title: RDA Finding
description: The single atomic output unit of every RDA skill. A report is an array of findings. Anything that is not expressible as a valid finding must not be asserted.

claim_class.description: FACT=verbatim from cited artifact or deterministic tool output. INFERENCE=derived from >=2 facts, derivation stated. HYPOTHESIS=plausible, unverified, check stated. UNKNOWN=required info absent from scope. EXTERNAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED=undecidable from source artifacts alone.

statement.description: The claim. Must be falsifiable and free of hedging adjectives.

derivation.description: REQUIRED when claim_class=INFERENCE. The explicit reasoning chain from cited facts to the claim.

evidence.description: MUST be non-empty for FACT and INFERENCE. MAY be empty only for UNKNOWN.

basis.description: Which rule in CONFIDENCE-AND-COVERAGE.md awarded this level.

evidence_independence.description: Count of mutually independent evidence sources.

coverage_ref.description: Pointer to the coverage record (population, inspected, sampling method) this finding was drawn from.

exploitability_assessed.description: Security findings only. false => the finding is a weakness, not a vulnerability.

blast_radius.description: What else breaks or is exposed if this is real. Must cite the dependency evidence that establishes the propagation path.

how_to_refute.description: The concrete command, file, or interview question that would prove this finding wrong.

disconfirming_check.description: The search actually performed for contradicting evidence, and its result.

question.description: Exact question to ask a human/system.

owner_role.description: Role, never a named individual inferred from git history.

system_of_record.description: e.g. cloud billing console, APM, ticketing, contract repository.

effort_band.description: Bands only. Never emit person-day point estimates from source inspection alone.

standard_refs.description: CWE / OWASP / NIST SSDF / ISO 25010 / control ids. Reference only; never asserts certification status.

attacker_controls.description: Required by RDA-11 s5b for injection, deserialisation, SSRF, path-traversal and code-execution findings: the attacker-supplied input, the parameter carrying it, each hop to the sink, and explicitly whether the attacker controls the executed STRUCTURE or only a VALUE substituted into it. Injection requires the former; a value interpolated as data by a parameterising layer or substituted into a constant format string is NOT_APPLICABLE.

quarantined.description: Set by the citation verifier when evidence fails to resolve. Quarantined findings MUST NOT appear in any executive output.

locator.description: repo-relative path with line range (path/to/file.py#L120-L138), or command string for TOOL_OUTPUT.

commit.description: Commit SHA the evidence was read at. Required for SOURCE/CONFIG/VCS_HISTORY/DOC -- the kinds verify_citations.py re-reads from the tree.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt. Must match the artifact byte-for-byte after whitespace normalisation.

quote_sha256.description: Hash of the normalised quote, recomputed by verify_citations.py.

independence_group.description: Evidence sharing a group id is NOT independent (e.g. two lines of the same file, or a tool and its own cached report).
